pageTitle: Diagnostic Pathology & Clinical Laboratory | CareFirst Clinic

hero.title: Advanced Pathology & Diagnostic Laboratory
hero.subtitle: Certified high-throughput laboratory delivering rapid, ultra-precise clinical biochemistry, hematology, immunology, and molecular testing. 99.8% precision with same-day digital reporting.

sectionHeader.title: Laboratory & Diagnostic Specialties
sectionHeader.subtitle: Automated, barcoded diagnostic workflows ensuring zero-contamination and rapid diagnostic turnaround times.

items.title: Comprehensive Biochemistry
items.text: Automated serum chemistry profiles including liver function tests (LFT), kidney function tests (KFT), lipid panels, and electrolyte evaluations.

items.title: Clinical Hematology & Coagulation
items.text: Advanced 5-part differential blood counts, hemoglobin electrophoresis, ESR, and complete coagulation profiles (PT/INR, APTT).

items.title: Immunology & Endocrine Panels
items.text: High-sensitivity chemiluminescent assays for thyroid hormones (T3, T4, TSH), vitamin D, vitamin B12, fertility profiles, and tumor markers.

items.title: Microbiology & Infectious Diseases
items.text: Automated blood cultures, bacterial antibiotic susceptibility testing, fungal staining, and rapid pathogen detection systems.

items.title: Molecular Diagnostics & PCR
items.text: Real-time RT-PCR technology for viral load quantification, respiratory pathogen panels, and genetic risk screenings.

items.title: Preventive Executive Health Packages
items.text: Comprehensive 75+ parameter full-body screening panels tailored for early detection of lifestyle disorders, diabetes, and cardiovascular risk.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Patients & Doctors Choose Our Pathology Center
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Clinical decisions demand uncompromising accuracy. Our accredited facility pairs robotic automation with meticulous certified pathologist oversight.

items.title: Fully Automated Analyzers
items.text: Barcoded, closed-tube robotic testing systems that eliminate human pipetting error and sample cross-contamination.

items.title: ISO 15189 Quality Accredited
items.text: Rigorous daily multi-level quality controls and international external quality assurance (EQAS) validations.

items.title: Ultra-Fast Digital Turnaround
items.text: Routine biochemistry and hematology reports verified and delivered securely via WhatsApp & portal in under 4 hours.

items.title: Gentle, Painless Phlebotomy
items.text: Micro-gauge butterfly needles and highly trained phlebotomists ensuring smooth, painless blood draw for adults & kids.

patientFeedback.title: What Patients Share After Lab Testing
patientFeedback.subtitle: Feedback from individuals and families who completed blood tests and health checkups with us.

items.name: Karan Malhotra
items.quote: Got my annual full-body checkup done at CareFirst. The blood sample collection with the butterfly needle was completely painless—I didn't feel a prick. All 12 specialized reports arrived on my phone within 4 hours, neatly flagged with doctor explanations.
items.outcome: Prompt Preventive Insights • Fast Digital Delivery

items.name: Sonia Verma
items.quote: The laboratory staff is extraordinarily clean, wearing fresh gloves and sanitized equipment for every patient. Their accurate automated thyroid readings gave my endocrinologist the exact precision needed to calibrate my medication after months of guesswork.

items.name: Rajesh Kapoor
items.quote: Booked an early morning home sample collection for my elderly mother. The phlebotomist arrived right on time at 7:00 AM, in clean scrubs and masked. He was gentle and courteous, and reports were ready by lunchtime.
items.outcome: Stress-Free Home Collection • Accurate Fast Results
